author: reek
body: The connective tissue: convert imported card rows (CardDb catalog) into the engine's CardTemplate values, so the rules engine, AI, and solver play with real cards instead of the procedural CardGen ones. Mana cost, type, power/toughness, supertypes, and keyword abilities are parsed from the row's Text fields. Complex Oracle abilities are not yet compiled (that is the Ability-IR phase); creatures come through as vanilla plus detected keywords, which the existing combat AI already handles.
